review_authorization: Root read the frozen source/contract reviews, accepted exact statements and source bindings with explicit limits, and authorized integration. Actual integration checks are recorded separately.

batched_vecmat_mult: Root accepted independent review of the eight frozen value/host modules and the separate no-K-premise output-address helper. The original wrapper allocates only fp32 A/B/output and has no dtype argument. The complete original per-program kernel executes every K/BK iteration with concrete fp32 products, an explicit valid reduction tree including zero seeds, transpose and ordered accumulator-first adds from positive zero. Its independent whole-memory reference and frame retain aliases; final memory is independent of unused backend callbacks. The host_nat_allocator profile preserves three allocations before ordered K/M/N guards, allocation failures, zero-divisor errors, positive/divisible prepared fields, tuning and the complete sequential pid0-fastest two-dimensional grid with previous actual/reference memory. All natural output addresses are bounded even when K=0, and actual program/lane write addresses are unique; no input/output separation or concurrency conclusion follows. Twelve accepted CPU source-wrapper captures and twelve error cases are metadata probes, not GPU execution or Lean cross-evaluation. Allocator freshness, zero initialization, contiguous storage, physical ABI and failure-side-effect refinement are unproved structural boundaries. Negative/Python caller domains, native widths, specialization/resources and concurrency remain open. Native FP.Config, reduction-tree and fusion correspondence are explicitly recorded numerical follow-up, not assumed laws.
kcache_copy_triton: Root accepted the independent four-module/source/receipt review and exact final source hashes. Ordered logical host preparation retains both cache layouts, 3D/4D keys, Torch-style reshape view-stride inference or snapshot copy, natural n including zero and n>1, all original stride arguments, errors and 3D grid. Every actual program reads prior actual memory; the independent reference advances prior reference memory and retains aliases and full frame. Materialized reshape preserves every 4D strided value. The new support lemmas derive universal successful-view address preservation from unchanged inferViewStrides/reshape: all 16 symbolic singleton partitions, arbitrary natural strides including zero/broadcast, rank-three metadata, bounded flattened leading index, every original Fin coordinate, and arbitrary reads with a common logical storage offset. Zero dimensions have empty index domains; metadata length remains covered. This closes the logical view-address subgap, while native Torch/allocation correspondence remains unproved. Six logical floating constructors include opaque legacy fp64, while only five raw machine formats were previously closed; nine discrete profiles share logical integer carriers. Lengths/tables always read signed Int and have no independent dtype arguments. Original ignored strides/unchecked shapes remain explicit. The 36 CPU cases and 35 Lean metadata checks do not establish universal native/source refinement. No numerical callback law or successful-execution/no-alias premise is introduced. Root separately read and accepted the frozen three-module universal view review. Supporting theorems add no public contract, numerical law, contiguity or injectivity premise, and do not strengthen the old public theorem statement.
